basis: Inherited hepatic bilirubin transport disorder; normal liver histology. Jaundice and bilirubinuria do not establish skin or kidney damage.
Malignant neoplasm of the adrenal gland, an endocrine organ.
Congenital structural anomaly of the atrial appendages.
Skeletal dysplasia defined by mesomelic limb shortening. Cardiac, renal and dental abnormalities are occasional (5-29%); external genital anomalies have no axis.
Defined by colorectal polyposis and colorectal cancer. Other cancer predispositions do not establish additional organ involvement.
Autoimmune inflammation directly affects the brain.
Inherited otosclerosis affects the otic capsule and stapes, impairing hearing; no generalized skeletal disease is established.
Disorder of cerebral object recognition; the definition does not establish damage to the eyes.
BCOR-altered sarcomas predominantly arise in bone or soft connective tissue. No additional organ involvement is established across the group.
Umbrella disorder localized to the conjunctiva; an immune mechanism does not apply to all subtypes.
Defined by disrupted cholesterol metabolism. Specific organ damage varies across subtypes and is not established for most patients.
Benign adipose tissue neoplasm located in the corpus callosum; intracranial location determines the axis.
Corneal ectasia with thinning and reduced visual acuity; keratoconus reported in 4/4 patients.
Benign mesenchymal soft tissue tumor, assigned to connective tissue; no specific visceral site or common additional organ damage is established.
Congenital failure of bony continuity or union in the femur, producing a false joint.
Carcinoma originates in anal canal mucosa. Liver, lung and skeletal tumors are occasional (5-29%); HPV association does not itself establish an infection diagnosis.
Hydrops is distension of the gallbladder, which belongs to the hepatic axis.
Fusion of toe phalangeal joints is a structural skeletal disorder.
Thyroid hormone transport disorder with euthyroid hyperthyroxinemia and possible goiter; no additional organ damage is established.
Defined by developmental delay or intellectual disability, with common epilepsy and hypotonia. Hypotonia alone does not establish skeletal muscle disease.
Tumor arises within the eye, usually from ciliary body epithelium, and directly impairs ocular structures and vision.
Defined by premature cranial suture fusion and hand or foot syndactyly. Long palpebral fissures do not establish ocular dysfunction.
Disseminated sclerosis denotes immune-mediated CNS demyelination; accompanying narcolepsy also lies within the neurologic axis.
Macular degeneration directly damages the retina. CX3CR1 association alone does not establish an autoimmune disease.
Unequal pupil size is an ocular abnormality. Neurologic causes occur in a subset; physiologic anisocoria causes no additional organ damage.
